attacks.summary: A mass combined attack on Kyiv killed four people and injured at least 62 according to reporting updated on April 16.
The same combined attack damaged civilian property in Kyiv Oblast; regional authorities reported no casualties.

incidents.summary: Production premises and a private house were damaged; no casualties were reported for the oblast attack.

damage.description: Production premises and a private house were damaged.

en.summary: Production premises and a private house were damaged; no casualties were reported for the oblast attack.

damage.description: Production premises and a private house were damaged.

uk.summary: Пошкоджено виробничі приміщення та приватний будинок; унаслідок атаки в області загиблих і поранених не повідомляли.

damage.description: Пошкоджено виробничі приміщення та приватний будинок.

incidents.summary: Four private houses, outbuildings and a vehicle were damaged; no casualties were reported for the oblast attack.

damage.description: Four private houses, outbuildings and a vehicle were damaged.

en.summary: Four private houses, outbuildings and a vehicle were damaged; no casualties were reported for the oblast attack.

damage.description: Four private houses, outbuildings and a vehicle were damaged.

uk.summary: Пошкоджено чотири приватні будинки, господарчі споруди та автомобіль; унаслідок атаки в області загиблих і поранених не повідомляли.

damage.description: Пошкоджено чотири приватні будинки, господарчі споруди та автомобіль.

incidents.summary: Multiple residential locations and nearby civilian buildings were damaged; two people, including a 12-year-old child, were killed and multiple people were injured.

damage.description: Residential facades and homes were damaged, including a high-rise; two hotel facades and nearby buildings were also damaged.

en.summary: Multiple residential locations and nearby civilian buildings were damaged; two people, including a 12-year-old child, were killed and multiple people were injured.

damage.description: Residential facades and homes were damaged, including a high-rise; two hotel facades and nearby buildings were also damaged.

uk.summary: Пошкоджено кілька житлових локацій і сусідні цивільні будівлі; загинули двоє людей, серед них 12-річна дитина, кілька людей дістали поранення.

damage.description: Пошкоджено фасади й житлові будинки, зокрема багатоповерхівку; також пошкоджено фасади двох готелів і прилеглі будівлі.

incidents.summary: Vehicles burned and a warehouse, tire service and shop were damaged; two people were killed and emergency responders were among those injured.

damage.description: Parked vehicles burned; a nearby warehouse, tire service and shop were damaged.

en.summary: Vehicles burned and a warehouse, tire service and shop were damaged; two people were killed and emergency responders were among those injured.

damage.description: Parked vehicles burned; a nearby warehouse, tire service and shop were damaged.

uk.summary: Горіли автомобілі, пошкоджено склад, шиномонтаж і магазин; двоє людей загинули, серед поранених були працівники екстрених служб.

damage.description: Горіли припарковані автомобілі; пошкоджено розташовані поруч склад, шиномонтаж і магазин.

incidents.summary: A fire occurred in a two-storey residential building; no injuries were reported at that location.

damage.description: A fire occurred in a two-storey residential building.

en.summary: A fire occurred in a two-storey residential building; no injuries were reported at that location.

damage.description: A fire occurred in a two-storey residential building.

uk.summary: У двоповерховому житловому будинку сталася пожежа; про поранених на цій локації не повідомляли.

damage.description: У двоповерховому житловому будинку сталася пожежа.

incidents.summary: Impacts were reported at a playground and near a residential building; no injuries were reported at those locations.

damage.description: Impacts were reported at a playground and near a residential building.

en.summary: Impacts were reported at a playground and near a residential building; no injuries were reported at those locations.

damage.description: Impacts were reported at a playground and near a residential building.

uk.summary: Зафіксовано влучання на дитячому майданчику та біля житлового будинку; про поранених на цих локаціях не повідомляли.

damage.description: Зафіксовано влучання на дитячому майданчику та біля житлового будинку.
